subject: Emotions
title: The Evolutionary Purpose
description: A 60-second lesson on The Evolutionary Purpose.

hook.text: Why would evolution keep an emotion that only causes suffering? Because jealousy protects your survival odds.

buildup.text: In ancestral environments, losing a mate or ally meant losing protection, food sharing, and offspring care.

discovery.text: Jealousy is a threat detection system. It monitors social bonds for signs of displacement before it happens.

twist.text: Envy serves a different purpose: it reveals what you value. The things you envy are clues to your desires.

climax.text: Both emotions become toxic when unchecked, but both carry useful data about threats and goals.

punchline.text: Jealousy guards your bonds. Envy maps your ambitions.
